value.summary: Management has demonstrated strong execution capabilities, delivering record quarterly revenues and maintaining healthy margins despite a volatile ordering environment. While they have scaled back some aggressive long-term targets, their credibility is supported by a debt-free balance sheet and a clear focus on high-margin, IP-owned technologies.

promises.quote: assume that 50% growth in the next two years, it even though it will be about 3300 or so, but we expect about Rs.4000 Crores of execution
promises.promised: Execute Rs. 4,000 Crores in revenue cumulatively over FY27 and FY28.
promises.actual_delivered: Management reaffirmed the Rs. 4,000 Crores cumulative target for FY27-28 in the Nov 2026 call (page 7), though they noted potential order delays.
promises.reasoning: The target remains in place, but the company is currently in the first year of this period and has noted that order timing remains a risk.

promises.quote: ARI on a standalone basis delivers currently around 25% as a PAT. Our target is once the complete integration of ARI is done with operations, it will average closer to what Zen averages
promises.promised: Improve ARI's PAT margins to match Zen's levels (approx. 30%+) following integration in FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: In May 2026 (page 17), ARI reported a PAT margin of 30.3%, aligning with Zen's historical performance.
promises.reasoning: The subsidiary's margins reached the targeted 30% level as reported in the FY26 annual results.

promises.quote: Next year we should have started manufacturing and supplying it.
promises.promised: Start manufacturing and supplying 30mm smart ammunition by FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: In Nov 2026 (page 15), management stated the product is still undergoing internal trials and they expect contribution by next year (FY28).
promises.reasoning: The timeline for commercial supply has shifted from FY27 to FY28 as trials continue.

guidance.target: Rs. 1,200 Crores to Rs. 1,300 Crores for FY27
guidance.quote: I think we should be able to achieve a little more than that number , b ut ye s, we are comfortable with that number very easily

guidance.target: Mid-30s Operational EBITDA margin for full year FY27
guidance.quote: We continue to guide a full-year operational EBITDA margin in the mid -30s.
For next financial year, which is FY 2028, also we budgeted a similar amount of capex to be done.

guidance.target: HyperStrike interceptor drone revenue starting FY28
guidance.quote: we expect the revenue from hyper strike to come from starting FY2028.

guidance.target: Targeting Rs. 2,500 Crores to Rs. 3,000 Crores by March 2027
guidance.quote: I think if the order book, as you said, if it is Rs.3000 Crores or something probably it should be a good ground for us to give very good numbers.

bull.point: The company achieved record quarterly execution in Q2 FY27, nearly doubling revenue sequentially.
bull.quote: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY 2027 stood at Rs.345.1 crores, a highest ever quarterly revenue

bull.point: Zen maintains a strong liquidity position with nearly Rs. 1,000 Crores in cash and zero debt.
bull.quote: We remain debt free with approximately Rs .968 Crores of cash and bank balances.

bull.point: The company owns 100% of its IP for critical systems like AESA radars and command and control software.
bull.quote: Everything, all the algorithms have been developed by us and as we speak, we are trying to improve those algorithms

bear.point: Working capital has deteriorated significantly to 379 days due to back-ended revenue and high advances to suppliers.
bear.quote: Our consolidated working capital cycle stood at 379 days as of September 30, 2026, compared with 255 days at the end of Q1.

bear.point: Operating cash flows for the first half of FY27 were negative due to the heavy working capital build-up.
bear.quote: The net operating cash flows for the half year was negative, but this is a function of the working capital build I described earlier.
